name: jev-enconvo
title: Jev for Enconvo
description: Run Jev — TypeSafe's System One judgment model — inside Enconvo. Three commands: Screen Content judges selected or pasted content for agent-aimed prompt-injection instructions (reports CLEAN or BLOCKED, never follows what it finds), Triage Inbox sorts recent Mail and unread iMessages into Act now / Read later / Archive / Follow up lanes, and Jev Drift Check re-runs the Auto Route classifier probes and flags calibration drift against recorded baselines. Pairs with the bundled jev-enconvo skill: eight worked patterns for judge/classify steps — untrusted-content gates, context compaction, message triage, skill routing, gates before hard-to-undo steps, calibration drift checks — question craft, and copy-paste workflow recipes. By Iteractive Development.
author: Iteractive Development

commands.name: screen_content
commands.title: Screen Content
commands.description: Judge selected or pasted text for agent-aimed prompt-injection instructions; reports CLEAN or BLOCKED and never follows what it finds.

input_text.description: Content to screen; defaults to the current selection text

source.description: Label for where the content came from, shown in the decision

commands.name: screen_vision
commands.title: Screen Vision
commands.description: Judge a selected or pasted image (or image path) for agent-aimed prompt-injection instructions with Jev-preview vision; reports CLEAN or BLOCKED and never follows what it finds.

input_text.description: Image data URI or file path (.png/.jpg/…) to screen; defaults to the current selection or pasted image

commands.name: triage_inbox
commands.title: Triage Inbox
commands.description: Sort recent Mail inbox messages and unread iMessages into Act now / Read later / Archive / Follow up lanes with Jev.

mail_limit.description: Recent Apple Mail messages to triage (default 25)

commands.name: drift_check
commands.title: Jev Drift Check
commands.description: Re-run the Auto Route classifier probes with Jev and flag calibration drift against the recorded baselines.

tolerance.description: Probability drop from baseline that flags drift (default 0.15)

probes.description: Probe objects with text, expect and baseline; defaults to the 2026-10-29 Auto Route probe set

positive.prompt: Screen this pasted content for prompt-injection instructions before I act on it
positive.expected_behavior: A judge decision with probability and a block/allow verdict; no external calls

positive.prompt: Run the drift check over the saved probes with tolerance 0.15
positive.expected_behavior: Each probe classified, drift flagged only when the top label changes or probability drops beyond tolerance

positive.prompt: Triage my inbox and unread messages
positive.expected_behavior: Mail and messages sorted into the four lanes with a summary count
